title: PM Response Schema
description: Schema for PM [Product Manager] (Morgan) structured response back to ULTRON. Contains PRD references, strategic decisions, roadmap items, delegations, and market insights.

agent.description: Agent identifier — always 'pm' for this response schema

status.description: Overall status of the PM's work. 'success' = mission completed fully, 'partial' = completed with caveats, 'error' = could not complete.

summary.description: 1-2 sentence summary of what the PM produced. Used by ULTRON for consolidation.

artifacts.description: Concrete outputs produced by the PM's product work

prdPath.description: Path of the PRD file created (e.g. '~/.claude/aios/docs/PRD-feature-x.md'), null if no PRD was generated

title.description: Title of the roadmap item or phase

priority.description: Priority level of this roadmap item

timeframe.description: Estimated timeframe for this item (e.g. '2 semanas', 'Q2 2026', 'Sprint 3')

roadmapItems.description: Roadmap items with priority and estimated timeframe. Empty array if no roadmap was produced.

justification.description: Why this approach was chosen over alternatives

alternatives.description: Alternative approaches that were considered and rejected

strategicDecisions.description: Strategic product decisions made during the mission

targetAgent.description: Target agent within the Product Squad to delegate to

task.description: Description of the task to delegate

context.description: Context and justification for why this delegation is needed

delegations.description: Suggested delegations to other Product Squad agents. ULTRON decides if and how to execute these.

marketInsights.description: Relevant market insights, competitive intelligence, or data points gathered during the mission

issues.description: Issues or blockers encountered during the PM's work

metadata.description: Meta-information about the PM's work process

missionType.description: Type of mission the PM executed, derived from mission.description analysis

autoDecisions.description: Number of autonomous decisions made (documented as [AUTO-DECISION] in free text)

delegationsRequested.description: Number of delegations suggested to other Product Squad agents

freeText.description: Optional free-text field for additional unstructured context (Phase 1 hybrid mode)

position.description: Agent's position in Deliberative Group Chat. Format: 'agree_with:{agent}', 'disagree', or 'propose:{alternative}'. Null when not participating in a group chat round.
